system.longDesc:
Capacity: 1 Slot

You have a built-in targeting system for ranged attacks, allowing you to perform the Precision Marksmanship stunt for –1 SP cost. If you make an attack with a firearm that benefits from an aim bonus before the end of your next turn, you automatically gain a +1 bonus, even without spending SP.

Game modifiers on this item: aimMnv +1 (Aim bonus with firearms, off). Items apply their modifiers while equipped; switch the ones that are off on when they apply.
